answers.core: This will greatly improve the rotation tool and can be a real time saver, instead of doing all axes one by one. If it were an add-on, most people wouldn't even know the time they could've saved.
answers.workaround: It could be an add-on or option in a menu, but that would hide it from people who really need it, searching through all those menus.

title: Add trackball-style rotation for 3D gizmo (like in Blender)
